Version changelog

v0.111.0 · Government, Biodomes and diplomatic mail 2026-10-14
  • Government receives a colony register, housing cap, population income bonus and explicit workforce Confirm/Reset controls.
  • Biodomes house 50 residents, feature original artwork and lore, and add a balanced CU/RU quest line.
  • Cruisers and Battleships also target population. Structure killers damage Biodomes and their occupants; battle calculator and reports show both effects.
  • Diplomacy alerts both alliances, with target-player Mail, narrative reports and Planetarion-style capture/XP bonuses.
  • Private player Mail includes inbox, sent messages, replies and pagination. Admin force key reveal is audited without recording secrets.
  • Fleet roster is transposed; launch bay, fleet readiness and structure tables are compact. Universe adds largest planets and population growth/loss rankings.
  • Private intel affiliations and nicknames no longer inherit public membership data.
  • Worker bribery triggers a six-tick mining strike; Biodome sabotage destroys habitats and occupants, with dedicated successful-operation quests.
  • Population adds 1 CU and 1 RP per complete 100 residents; income shows separate refinery and Finance Centre contributions.
Full news article →
v0.110.0 · Order refresh, fleet roster and achievement receipts 2026-10-14
  • Successful asteroid, ship, construction, research and alliance structure orders save and reload the current game page. Draft edits and rejected orders do not reload.
  • Mining begins with Income per tick, styled like the Resource Bank and showing owned asteroid counts per resource.
  • Construction lists owned buildings, queued reservations, free slots, affordable quantities, next costs and bonus information.
  • All Ships moves the entire selected source fleet. Amount is ignored for that option; source and destination selections persist. Deployed fleets cannot transfer.
  • Fleet Roster lists ship names with separate Class, Target 1, Target 2 and Target 3 columns. Missing targets are blank.
  • Manual, bulk and automatic Achievement claims produce a festive receipt with claimed objectives, gold claim medals and exact totals by reward type.
  • New and reset rounds assign 0% workforce. Department limits are 25/50/35/60/50%; the available pool starts at 50% and reaches 100% through Population Management research.
Full news article →
v0.109.0 · Alliance fleet readiness and command interface 2026-10-14
  • Alliance Fleet is shown first. Player fleets 1–3 are collapsed behind a plus; fleets reported on a mission are hidden.
  • Fleet tables separate ship class and three target priorities; same-galaxy alliance defence shows ETA 5.
  • Ticker information displays state, current tick, interval, next tick, schedule and last processed tick, with visible action confirmations.
  • Galaxy Browser totals span the complete roster and optional intel columns.
  • Galaxy Politics uses a council briefing and clearer policy forms. Galaxy Fund shows reserve allocation and treasury cards.
  • Similar submenus share rounded theme-aware buttons and a clear selected state.
Full news article →
v0.108.0 · Alliance attack claims and fleet worksheet 2026-10-13
  • Alliance Attack tool adds private targets and one active claim per player; administrators cannot bypass claim limits or claim permissions.
  • Owner, HC and Officer can manage operations by default; Members can claim targets. Recruitment ranks cannot claim by default.
  • Calculator uses one compact ship worksheet with Attacker and Defender columns, class colours, arrow-key navigation and spreadsheet paste.
  • Fresh game state explicitly stops the ticker and clears the scheduled start; resetting a round clears attack targets and claims.
Full news article →
v0.107.0 · Control panels, account ranks and player-only round 2026-10-13
  • User control panel and Staff control panel have clear, non-duplicated submenus. The portal header aligns with the main content and account box.
  • Staff workspaces use native portal banners; game banners and ornate frames are removed. Fields, KPI boxes, keyholder controls and structure artwork are spaced consistently.
  • Alliance manager reserves up to five inactive alliances with encrypted personal keys, edits the current active alliance and adds up to two additional keyholders.
  • Account ranks include Player, Support, Multihunter and Administrator; only Administrators change ranks and at least one must remain.
  • Staff planet audit records committed field changes, previous/new values and the actor. Support and Multihunter can read the audit.
  • Requested cleanup removes non-player planets and alliances while preserving personal reservations. Practice planets no longer automatically return.
  • Reset leaves the ticker stopped with the previous schedule cleared. Manual or newly scheduled starts can enable it.
  • Battle calculator outputs simulated news reports only on its own page, without adding them to Journal. Uplink test reports remain in their test module.
  • Archive Forums lists only the current galaxy and alliance forums. The Foreign Affairs Galaxy Forum link is removed.
Full news article →
v0.106.0 · Portal-themed staff tools and alliance confirmation 2026-10-13
  • Staff workspaces match the current portal theme and keep the gameplay theme separate.
  • Restore an alliance is always expanded. Successful alliance creation shows an Owner confirmation box with disclosure status.
  • The standalone Reset round tab is removed from Staff control panel; round controls remain in Admin Controlcenter.
  • Staff workspace bootstrap is bundled into the established portal and game loading paths.
Full news article →
v0.105.0 · Compact portal release ledger 2026-10-13
  • Portal version changelog shows only the latest ten releases.
  • Historical release articles remain available through the news archive.
Full news article →
v0.104.0 · Portal staff workspaces and optional original view 2026-10-13
  • Staff control panel owns Admin Controlcenter, Alliance Controlcenter, Multihunters and support alongside users and news administration.
  • Dedicated staff workspaces use a separate browser save and do not automatically advance the staff gameplay planet or submit its fleet snapshots.
  • The ingame Administration menu is hidden by default. Staff control panel provides a toggle and link to the original ingame staff view.
  • Existing administrator API permissions still protect every staff operation.
Full news article →
v0.103.0 · Staff structure workspace and simulated battle lab 2026-10-13
  • Alliance Controlcenter Structures shows slots 11–15, current occupants and construction progress, plus a staff generator for the selected alliance.
  • Staff can queue a three-tick build or immediately activate a timed structure. Occupied slots, invalid coordinates and duplicate active types are rejected.
  • Satelite Uplink includes a random simulated battle lab. Reports also appear in Journal and load the original fleets into the battle calculator.
  • Simulation changes no real fleets, resources, asteroids or Multihunter movement evidence.
Full news article →
v0.102.0 · Portal account access and requested alliance reset 2026-10-13
  • User Control Panel includes Create account. Portal has a themed right-side login/registration prompt and signed-in account links.
  • Requested one-time alliance reset removes alliance registrations, Owner keys and disclosure phrases; accounts and planet/ruler identities are preserved.
  • Planet affiliations become Unaffiliated and stale alliance UI is cleared when central data refreshes.
Full news article →
